data: In the first diagram, how many circles are there??

The first diagram is a 2-I-2-TISL SFST for LHOR. The diagram contains several circles representing states. To count the circles, I will carefully examine the diagram:

1. There is one circle labeled "start" at the beginning of the diagram.
2. There are two circles labeled "H".
3. There are two circles labeled "L".

Adding these up, there are a total of 5 circles in the first diagram.
